verdict.rationale: Weave exposes a REST Service API for programmatic access to traces/evaluations and supports OTLP-based trace import/export endpoints, which a developer could use to build custom exports, but there is no documented feature for bulk-exporting traces or datasets directly to blob storage (S3/GCS) or a data warehouse (BigQuery/Snowflake/etc). missing for 10: native blob-storage export connector, data-warehouse sync/export integration, documented bulk-export workflow or CLI command for dumping datasets.
